jobDescription:
Who are we

Equinix is the worlds digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriersbecause progress starts with fresh ideas. Youll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes youbecause when you feel valued, youre empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform''s architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps.

This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves.

You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.

Responsibilities

OS Provisioning Bare-Metal Infrastructure

  • Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap

  • Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention

  • Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them

Kubernetes Control Plane Worker Nodes

  • Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones

  • Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node

  • Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded

CI/CD Data Plane Deployment

  • Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates

  • Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks

Network

  • Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation

  • Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over

OS Kubernetes Upgrades

  • Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change

  • Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live

  • Apply the platform''s patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Management Plane

  • Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes

  • Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free

On-Call Incident Management

  • Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events

  • Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting

  • Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate

What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months

  • Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps

  • Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion

  • Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration

  • OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks

  • etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live

  • Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane

  • Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements

Qualifications

Required

  • OS bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening

  • Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement

  • Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management

  • Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling

  • CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet

  • Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it

  • Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet

  • Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage

  • On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response

  • Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations

Preferred

  • Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance-testing pipeline around one

  • SR-IOV NIC tuning and data-plane performance validation

  • SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)

  • Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform

  • Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

  • Advise financial and non-financial Institutions across risk management areas such as risk strategy, transformation programs, enterprise risk, portfolio management, capability maturity assessments, fraud and financial crime risk compliance.

  • Good project management skills and demonstrated experience in managing teams across functions and geographies
  • Strong business acumen and knowledge of risk management process
  • Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight
  • Strong writing skills to build point of views on current industry trends

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills

Cross-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic consulting environment

3+ years of risk management experience at one or more Financial Services institutions, Rating Agency or Professional Services OR Risk Advisory with an understanding of one or more of the following areas:

  • An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients

  • Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Qualification

Experience: 3+ years

descriptionFromApi:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Analyst, AI & Data Strategy-1

Sr. Analyst, Master Data Management
Location: Gurgaon, India
Reports to: Vice President, Master Data Management

About the Position
The Sr. Analyst of Master Data Management (MDM) is responsible for execution of Mastercard s MDM strategy across the enterprise. This role is instrumental in shaping and implementing the strategic vision for MDM initiatives, ensuring alignment with broader enterprise data governance goals.
In close partnership with business and technology stakeholders, the Sr. Analyst will operationalize MDM and governance practices to uphold the consistency, accuracy, and integrity of mastered data assets. This role demands strong cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders across Franchise, Product, Corporate, Mastercard Technology, and global business units to drive and sustain the data management strategy.
As a subject matter expert in master and reference data management, this individual will represent the Office of the Chief Data Officer (CDO) in executing MDM best practices to promote enterprise-wide data excellence.

Key Responsibilities
Design & Implementation: Design and implement Master Data Management (MDM) solutions aligned with strategic business objectives and guided by leadership direction. Key responsibilities include gathering requirements, architecting solutions, configuring platforms such as Reltio, and maintaining ongoing operations. descriptionFromApi:
As a Full Stack AI Platform Engineer here at Honeywell, you will design, build, and scale AI systems end-to-end - from high-throughput IoT streaming pipelines and knowledge graph infrastructure, through LLM orchestration and RAG services, to the React-based interfaces that surface autonomous insights to plant engineers, facility managers, and OT security analysts.

We are seeking a Full Stack AI Platform Engineer to join our Data Engineering, AI & ML Platform team. This role is central to designing, building, and scaling the enterprise AI/ML platform that powers intelligent automation across a global portfolio.

You will work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning operations, and edge AI - building production-grade infrastructure that processes billions of IoT events from building management systems, deploys models to edge devices, and enables AI-driven applications including predictive diagnostics, energy monitoring, and RAG-based knowledge systems.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, ships production systems, and can operate across the full stack from cloud-native platforms to edge GPU hardware

YOU MUST HAVE

- Bachelors degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics.

- 3 plus years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or ML platform engineering.

- Strong proficiency in Python and at least one systems language (Python, Go, Rust, C++).

- Deep hands-on experience with cloud-native data platforms (Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Data Lake, Kubernetes).

- Production experience building and deploying ML/AI pipelines including model serving, feature engineering, and experiment tracking.

- Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and Langsmith or equivalent agentic AI orchestration tools.

- Experience with edge AI deployment on NVIDIA Jetson or similar embedded GPU platforms.

- Experience with knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, or semantic web technologies.

WE VALUE

- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field.

- Background in building management systems, HVAC, energy management, or industrial IoT domains.

- Strong leadership and management skills.

- Experience working in an agile development environment.

- Proven ability to drive successful cloud development projects and initiatives.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

- Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving capability.

Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Platform Engineering

- Develop high-performance, production-ready Python APIs using FastAPI to serve as the primary interface for on-device model inference

- Design, build, and maintain enterprise AI/ML platform services on multi-cloud infrastructure including model deployment, serving and experiment tracking.

- Build robust CI/CD stacks to automate the testing of inference logic and the deployment of API services to edge devices.

- Implement ML orchestration workflows using LangGraph, MLflow, and custom orchestration layers for multi-agent AI systems.

- Develop and integrate AI workloads using ML-Ops and tracing tools like LangSmith.

- Design and implement automated data processing pipelines within FastAPI to handle real-time sensor or image inputs for the model.

- Bridge the gap between research and deployment by converting code from experimental into modular, maintainable Python packages.

Edge AI & Inference

- Ability to integrate and run pre-built AI models on local hardware using standard industry runtimes.

- Skilled at building the software logic required to process data inputs and handle model outputs efficiently.

- Expert at developing Python-based services and automating their deployment to devices via standardized pipelines.

- Capable of monitoring and optimizing software to run reliably within strict memory and hardware limitations.

- Experience deploying containerized models from Azure to edge devices using Azure IoT Edge or managed online endpoints

Data & Knowledge Engineering

- Experience building pipelines to structure, clean, and store data for model training or real-time retrieval (RAG) on edge devices

- Ability to convert experimental data processing logic from notebooks into production-ready Python modules.

- Design automated workflows to collect, label, and manage datasets, ensuring high-quality data is available for continuous model improvement.

Production Operations & Reliability

- Own platform reliability for AI services serving multiple business units.

- Implement observability, monitoring, and alerting for ML pipelines and inference services.

- Drive cost optimization across data platform workloads, cloud compute, and storage infrastructure.

- Proficient in using Azure Machine Learning Studio to manage the full lifecycle of models, including registration, versioning, and monitoring.

Transformation Analyst - Agentic Process Transformation

Rights & Royalties Transformation

Role Summary

We are seeking a high-impact Business Transformation Analyst to help modernise the Rights & Royalties operating model through AI-enabled agents, workflow automation, process simplification and measurable efficiency gains. This role is designed for someone who can understand operational pain points quickly, convert them into practical automation opportunities, and deliver adoption-ready solutions that improve speed, quality, control and stakeholder experience.


The ideal candidate combines structured business analysis with a maker mindset: able to map processes, define requirements, build low-code/agentic solutions, partner with technology teams, and track outcomes through clear KPIs. Hands-on data capability remains important, but the emphasis is on using data, AI and automation to transform recurring operational work, not on deep engineering or specialist BI development.


Royalties, rights, licensing, finance operations, publishing/media or revenue-share experience will be a strong advantage, particularly where it supports understanding of contracts, statements, payments, deductions, reserves, exceptions, approvals and audit sensitivity.


Key Objectives - What Success Looks Like

  • Create practical AI agents and guided automations that reduce manual effort, improve response quality and accelerate decision-making across Rights & Royalties operations.
  • Simplify and standardise recurring workflows such as exception triage, approvals, reconciliations, case routing, notifications, quality checks and reporting packs.
  • Deliver measurable efficiency gains through cycle-time reduction, lower rework, improved SLA performance, better adoption and stronger process controls.
  • Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and adoption plans.
  • Enable operational leaders with concise, self-serve visibility into risks, bottlenecks, productivity, quality and customer impact.

Core Responsibilities

1) Process Transformation & Business Analysis

  • Conduct rapid discovery of current-state processes, pain points, root causes, handoffs, control gaps and duplication across Rights, Royalties and related Finance Operations.
  • Design future-state workflows using a transformation lens: Simplify -> Standardise -> Automate -> Augment with AI -> Scale.
  • Convert business needs into crisp requirements, user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
  • Prioritise opportunities based on effort, impact, control risk, adoption readiness and efficiency potential.
  • Support UAT, adoption, change communication, training aids and post-launch benefit tracking.

2) Agent Creation & AI-enabled Solutions

  • Help design, configure and improve business-facing agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem.
  • Translate operational use cases into agent capabilities such as document review support, answer retrieval, exception explanation, guided decisioning, case summarisation and next-best-action recommendations.
  • Define agent knowledge sources, prompts/instructions, guardrails, escalation paths, testing scenarios, success metrics and adoption feedback loops.
  • Partner with technology, governance and business stakeholders to ensure agents are controlled, explainable, secure, measurable and fit for production use.
  • Identify where agents should be combined with workflows, for example where AI reasoning is needed within a structured approval, triage or notification process.

3) Workflow Automation & Operational Enablement

  • Build or support low-code automations using Power Automate, Copilot Studio workflows and connected Microsoft 365 services.
  • Automate high-volume, rule-led and repeatable activities including validations, approvals, reminders, case routing, exception logging, report refreshes and stakeholder notifications.
  • Design automations with appropriate audit trails, handoffs, fallback logic, approval controls, ownership and maintainability.
  • Work with operations teams to ensure automation is embedded into daily routines rather than remaining as a standalone tool.

4) Insights, KPIs & Benefit Realisation

  • Define outcome-led KPI frameworks for automation and process transformation, focused on hours saved, cycle time, quality, SLA, adoption, controls and customer impact.
  • Use dashboards and reporting tools to monitor transformation outcomes, bottlenecks, adoption and benefit delivery.
  • Perform practical analysis to identify trends, anomalies and improvement opportunities related to royalty statements, adjustments, disputes, metadata, reserves, payments or case volumes.
  • Prepare concise executive-ready summaries that convert analysis into business decisions and action plans.

5) Governance, Controls & Documentation

  • Create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, decision logs, control points, KPI definitions and adoption materials.
  • Ensure automation and agent assets have clear ownership, change control, traceability, testing evidence and governance alignment.
  • Strengthen audit readiness through reconciliation checkpoints, exception logs, approval matrices and documented process logic.

Typical Outcomes / KPIs You May Own

  • Automation and agent benefit realisation: hours saved, cost avoidance, productivity uplift and reduced manual touchpoints.
  • Cycle-time and SLA improvement across targeted royalty, rights, finance operations or query-management workflows.
  • Reduction in rework, avoidable escalations, duplicate handling, leakage risk and control exceptions.
  • Agent and automation adoption: active users, usage frequency, completion rate, deflection rate, satisfaction and feedback themes.
  • Quality and reliability: successful workflow runs, exception rates, data accuracy, audit trail completeness and refresh reliability.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3-4 years experience in a Business Analyst, Transformation Analyst, Automation Analyst, Process Analyst, Product Operations or comparable role.
  • Strong process discovery and problem-solving capability, with the ability to simplify complex operational work into clear, actionable requirements.
  • Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Power Platform, preferably Power Automate and Copilot Studio, or a demonstrable ability to build low-code automations and AI-enabled business solutions.
  • Ability to define agent or automation use cases, map workflows, document requirements, test outputs, manage feedback and support adoption.
  • Strong stakeholder management across Operations, Finance, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance or Legal stakeholders.
  • Good analytical capability and comfort working with operational data, KPIs and dashboards. Familiarity with SQL, Tableau, Looker, BigQuery or similar tools is useful, but not the primary focus of the role.
  • Excellent communication skills: concise documentation, clear visuals, executive-ready summaries and practical training materials.
  • Outcome ownership and delivery pace: able to move from discovery to MVP to adoption with discipline and urgency.

Preferred / Advantageous

  • Exposure to royalties, rights, licensing, publishing/media, revenue-share, finance operations or contract-driven processes.
  • Understanding of the royalty lifecycle: contract terms, rate structures, deductions, reserves, statements, payments, recoupment, audit queries and dispute handling.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, SharePoint, Teams, Excel-based operations, document repositories or workflow-heavy operational environments.
  • Familiarity with process mapping tools such as Blueworks, Visio or Lucidchart; Lean, continuous improvement or process re-engineering methods.
  • Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, access control, knowledge-source hygiene and governance considerations for enterprise agents.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Business, Operations, IT, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
  • Postgraduate qualification such as MBA, PG Diploma in Business Analytics, Operations, Finance or Transformation is a differentiator, not mandatory.
  • Relevant certifications in Power Platform, Copilot Studio, automation, business analysis, Lean/process improvement, data analytics or BI are advantageous.

Behavioural Competencies - Non-negotiable for Transformation

  • Agentic mindset: thinks beyond reporting and looks for ways to remove, automate or augment work.
  • Adaptability, speed and agility: moves quickly from ambiguity to working MVPs and iterates based on feedback.
  • Outcome ownership: focuses on measurable improvement, not activity completion.
  • Structured problem-solving: separates symptoms from root cause and prioritises by business impact and control risk.
  • Precision and control mindset: understands the financial, contractual and audit sensitivity of royalties operations.
  • Collaboration and influence: earns trust across operations and technology, handles competing priorities and drives closure.

Working Relationships

Works closely with Rights & Royalties Operations, Finance Operations, Transformation leads, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance/Legal and operational leaders. Acts as a process transformation, agent enablement and automation partner to teams looking to improve efficiency, control and customer experience.

  • A practical platform to convert process knowledge into scalable digital and AI-enabled solutions.

jobDescription:
Title: AI Engineer

Experience: 3-7 years

Location: Chennai (UK Shift - Mandatory WFO)


Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in Python (NumPy, Pandas, PyTorch/TensorFlow, scikit learn).
Experience building and deploying production ML models.
Hands on experience with cloud AI services (such as GCP Vertex AI).
Knowledge of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, Google ADK and prompt engineering.
Experience with REST APIs, microservices, and event driven architectures.
Data & Engineering

Solid understanding of SQL and data warehousing concepts.
Familiarity with MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, GitHub Actions, etc.).
Experience with distributed data processing.


Job Description:
Design, train, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models for forecasting, recommendations, personalization, pricing optimization, fraud detection, and demand planning.
Develop LLM powered solutions (RAG pipelines, agents, copilots) using internal and external data sources.
Apply NLP, time series analysis, and predictive modeling to large scale enterprise datasets.
Platform & Engineering
Build and maintain end to end ML pipelines (data ingestion, training inference monitoring).
Implement MLOps practices including CI/CD, model versioning, drift detection, and performance monitoring.
Deploy AI solutions using cloud native services (GCP (preferrerd), Azure or AWS) with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
Data & Analytics
Partner with data engineers to curate, clean, and transform structured and unstructured data at scale.
Optimize feature engineering and model performance using distributed computing frameworks (Spark, Ray, etc.).
Business & Stakeholder Collaboration
Work closely with product managers, architects, and business leaders to translate business problems into AI solutions.
Support AI enablement across vendor and reseller ecosystems through insights and automation embedded in Xvantage.
Governance & Responsible AI
Ensure models comply with security, privacy, and responsible AI standards.
Improve model explainability, fairness, and auditability for enterprise and regulatory needs.
Required Qualifications

Education & Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field.
3 to 7 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or applied data science (level dependent).
Preferred Qualifications

Experience in digital commerce, supply chain, pricing, or distribution domains.
Exposure to agentic AI frameworks and autonomous workflows.
Knowledge of enterprise scale data governance and security practices.
Experience supporting AI products used by thousands of users globally

title: Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery

jobDescription:
AIVAR INNOVATIONS
Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
3-5 Years | Coimbatore/ Bangalore |Full-Time
About Aivar Innovations
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services and software company and an AWS Preferred Partner, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Sorin Investments. We ship production-grade AI into enterprise environments across fintech, healthcare, and technology. Our work is anchored by four accelerator platforms: Convogent (voice and agent AI automation), Velogent (governed agentic process automation for regulated industries), Kubogent (Kubernetes-native AIOps), and Datagent (data and analytics). We measure ourselves by what runs in production, not by slideware.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Senior Voice AI Engineer for Aivars Delivery organization to take voice AI use cases from discovery through live production for our enterprise customers. You will build and customize voice agents on top of Convogent - Aivars voice AI accelerator - working directly within customer engagements, delivery timelines, and SOW commitments. This is a hands-on engineering role embedded in customer-facing delivery pods, partnering closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and customer technical stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes on live calls.
What Youll Do
  • Own customer delivery outcomes. Take voice AI use cases from discovery through production go-live within committed timelines, working inside Rocketlane-tracked delivery plans alongside your Delivery Manager.
  • Customize and configure Convogent. Adapt Aivars voice AI accelerator (built on Pipecat, LiveKit) to each customers telephony stack (Twilio, Exotel, Cisco, Vonage, etc.), API/MCP integrations with customer CRM tools, knowledge base (KB) integrations, compliance constraints, and use-case requirements.
  • Engineer real-time audio pipelines for production. Optimize STT and TTS flows for the latency, concurrency, and call quality bar each customer engagement demands.
  • Troubleshoot customer production systems. When a live call does not sound right, quickly narrow down where in the pipeline it broke - capture, STT, orchestration, or TTS - by asking the right questions, reading the right signals, and driving the fix through to resolution.
  • Build and adapt the orchestration layer. Connect STT, TTS, and LLM agents into resilient, observable workflows with guardrails suited to the customers risk and compliance profile.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable solutions. Work directly with customer technical stakeholders alongside Aivars SA and DM to scope, size, and iterate use cases against measurable outcomes - success rate, latency, adoption.
  • Report and govern delivery. Contribute to sprint tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder governance for the use cases you own.
What Youll Bring
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying voice agents with Pipecat, LiveKit, or similar frameworks - ideally across multiple distinct production deployments, not a single system.
  • Deep expertise in STT (Deepgram, Whisper, AssemblyAI, Google STT, Sarvam) and TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Amazon Polly).
  • Working knowledge of Speech-to-Speech (S2S) services, including Amazon Nova Sonic, and how they change pipeline and orchestration design compared to cascaded STT/LLM/TTS.
  • Experience with multi-speaker diarization and conversation segmentation.
  • Production fluency in Python plus at least one of Node.js, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Practical use of AI/ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and conversational AI design - prompt engineering and integration with LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Bedrock models).
  • Cloud deployment experience on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, EKS, Polly, Transcribe, Bedrock) with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under SOW/contract constraints - scoping, prioritizing, and shipping within a defined timeline and budget across live customer engagements.
  • Comfort working across multiple concurrent customer engagements with differing requirements, tech stacks, and stakeholders.
Preferred Experience
  • Prior experience in a customer delivery, consulting, or systems integration role, rather than purely product/platform engineering.
  • Exposure to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, BFSI) and their compliance and security constraints.
  • Experience with enterprise stakeholder management - running status calls, translating technical tradeoffs into business language.
  • Familiarity with low-code voice platforms alongside custom infrastructure.
  • Voice analytics, transcription tooling, and Indian-language STT/TTS models.
  • AWS or speech technology certifications.

Why This Role, Why Aivar

  • Work that ships to real customers. Every use case you build runs live on enterprise calls, measured by customer outcomes, not demos.
  • Own delivery end-to-end. From discovery call to production go-live, you are the engineering owner of the customers voice AI outcome.
  • Build on accelerators that work. Convogent has real production traction - you configure and extend a working platform across diverse customer environments.

Job Summary

Kuku TV is looking for a Mid-Senior Video Editor (2-5 years) who can turn scripts, performances, live-action footage, and AI-generated visuals into high-retention, binge-worthy micro-dramas. This role is ideal for an editor who understands that great short-form storytelling is not just about cutting footage-it s about hooking viewers, building emotion, escalating conflict, and ending every episode with a reason to watch the next one.

You ll work across live-action + AI-generated content in a fast-paced, high-volume episodic production environment.

Responsibilities

Storytelling Editing

  • Edit live-action and AI-generated micro-dramas for mobile-first audiences.
  • Create powerful opening hooks, emotional peaks, reveals, twists, payoffs, and cliffhangers.
  • Shape dialogue, performances, music, SFX, voiceovers, and visuals into compelling narratives.
  • Select the strongest takes to maximise emotion, conflict, suspense, and character relationships.
  • Maintain strong pacing, visual rhythm, dialogue clarity, narrative progression, and audience retention.
  • Apply principles of information control, escalating conflict, pattern interruption, and retention-driven editing.

Mobile-First Storytelling

  • Edit specifically for vertical 9:16 formats and mobile viewing.
  • Maintain strong composition, visual hierarchy, readable performances, and screen impact.
  • Understand how to optimise storytelling for short attention spans and binge consumption.

AI Video VFX

  • Work confidently with AI-generated characters, environments, performances, and shots.
  • Identify and fix AI-video issues such as facial inconsistencies, lip-sync errors, flickering, warping, unnatural movement, frame instability, and continuity issues.
  • Handle AI-assisted post-production including lip-sync correction, cleanup, upscaling, frame interpolation, shot extension, masking, tracking, compositing, and background replacement.
  • Know when an AI shot can be fixed in post-production and when it needs to be regenerated.

Visual Sound Finishing

  • Seamlessly integrate live-action and AI footage through colour correction, grading, reframing, compositing, motion treatment, and visual matching.
  • Create titles, captions, transitions, motion graphics, VFX, recaps, end cards, and promotional elements when required.
  • Handle dialogue editing, music, ambience, Foley, and SFX to strengthen emotional and dramatic impact.
  • Ensure clear audio balance across mobile devices and viewing environments.

Production Collaboration

  • Maintain story, character, costume, location, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and performance continuity.
  • Manage multiple episodes, revisions, and priorities in a fast-moving production pipeline.
  • Collaborate with directors, writers, creative producers, AI artists, and sound designers.
  • Implement feedback accurately and meet tight delivery timelines.
  • Maintain organised project files, proxies, media libraries, naming conventions, version histories, templates, and archival masters.
  • Perform creative and technical QC and deliver final episodes to required platform, codec, resolution, frame-rate, aspect-ratio, and audio specifications.

What we re looking for

Must Have

  • 2-7 years of professional video-editing experience, preferably in fiction, micro-dramas, web series, films, TV, advertising, digital entertainment, or narrative short-form content.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, dramatic pacing, emotional editing, and technical polish.
  • Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills.
  • Advanced Adobe after Effects skills, including compositing, masking, and tracking, cleanup, and motion graphics.
  • Strong knowledge of Gen AI tool - Runaway, ElevanLabs, Kling, Veo, Adobe Firefly, Topaz or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve for colour correction, grading, finishing, and media management.
  • Strong understanding of narrative structure, screen direction, continuity, performance selection, montage, shot progression, and visual rhythm.
  • Experience editing dialogue-driven scenes, romance, emotional sequences, action, confrontations, reveals, and cliffhangers.
  • Strong understanding of audience retention and mobile-first 9:16 storytelling.
  • Experience working with both live-action and AI-generated footage.
  • Strong understanding of sound editing, dialogue balancing, music placement, ambience, Foley, and SFX.
  • Ability to colour-match footage from different cameras, tools, and production pipelines.
  • Strong eye for character, facial, costume, prop, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and background continuity.
  • Ability to manage multiple episodes, revisions, and deadlines in a high-volume production environment.

AI Experience

Experience with generative AI video/image, lip-sync, cleanup, enhancement, upscaling, interpolation, shot extension, and compositing workflows is highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluent Hindi and working proficiency in English.
  • Experience with micro-dramas, vertical dramas, episodic fiction, web series, or retention-driven entertainment.
  • Experience in fast-turnaround, high-volume episodic production.
  • Familiarity with subtitles, dubbing, localisation, and multilingual versioning.
  • Knowledge of proxy workflows, shared storage, media relinking, project templates, automated syncing, and structured post-production handoffs.
  • Basic understanding of OTT and digital-platform delivery standards.
  • Film editing, filmmaking, media production, animation, or related degree/diploma is a plus, but not mandatory.

jobDescription:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.
About the Role
You ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.
Responsibilities :
  • Invent a realistic developer scenario - a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature - not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands - deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20-60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors tasks as a QA reviewer.
Not in scope
  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship - you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles - scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships - quality over quantity.
Requirements

- The whole AWS footprint as Terraform code : Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Container Service (ECS) Fargate, Relational Database Service (RDS) PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Simple Storage Service (S3), OpenSearch, Redis, EventBridge and CloudFront.

- Observability in practice: you have been on call, and you have tuned alerts that were too noisy.

Good to have
- Compliance work: ISO 27001, SOC 2, or Indian health data regulation.
- On-premise or hybrid deployments, and hardware appliances in the field.
- Real cost optimisation on a live bill.
- Experience supporting customers with unreliable connectivity.

Your first 90 days
- Month 1 - all environments live, CI/CD running, the walking skeleton deployed automatically.
- Month 2 - monitoring, alerting and centralised logs in place; backups running with a tested restore.
- Month 3 - the edge gateway image built and running against analyser simulators.

How we work
Two-week sprints. Everything is code - infrastructure included. Code review on every pull request.
Required Skills
GitHub Actions Docker Terraform CI/CD AWS ECS / Fargate Amazon Web Services (AWS) AWS RDS / PostgreSQL AWS IAM

We are looking for a Quality Assurance professional with hands-on experience in customer queries and documentation management to support:
  • Discovery of client document structures
  • Verification of AI-generated RFI responses
  • Identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and risks
  • Training and improving AI models using real-world validation
This role sits at the intersection of QA, documentation, and AI-assisted workflows .

Key Responsibilities 1. Client Document Discovery & Structuring
  • Analyze and understand client document repositories (policies, SOPs, manuals, certifications, reports, etc.)
  • Identify how different companies organize and maintain documentation
  • Classify documents based on relevance to RFIs, audits, compliance, and customer queries
  • Support creation of structured AI-ready knowledge bases from unstructured documents

2. RFI & Questionnaire Validation (AI Output Review)
  • Review AI-generated RFI / questionnaire responses for:
    • Accuracy against source documents
    • Completeness and relevance
    • Consistency across responses
    • Compliance and risk sensitivity
  • Identify and flag incorrect, ambiguous, outdated, or potentially risky responses
  • Suggest corrections or improvements based on domain understanding
  • Act as a final human validation layer before responses are shared with customers

3. AI Training & Continuous Improvement
  • Provide feedback loops to improve AI response quality
  • Help label and tag data used for AI training
  • Assist in defining validation rules and quality benchmarks for AI outputs
  • Participate in testing new AI features and workflows

4. Quality Assurance & Process Support
  • Define QA checklists for RFI responses and document usage
  • Help standardize response format, language, tone, and structure across customers
  • Help identify gaps in documentation coverage
  • Collaborate with product, AI, and engineering teams to improve workflows

Required Skills & Experience Must-Have
  • 2+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Quality Management roles, documentation, compliance, or customer query handling role
  • Strong experience handling:
    • Customer questionnaires / RFIs
    • Internal documentation (policies, SOPs, manuals, certifications)
  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking
  • Ability to validate content against source documents
  • Comfortable working with structured and unstructured data
  • Good written communication skills (English)

Preferred / Nice-to-Have
  • Experience in:
    • Certification bodies, audit firms, consulting, sustainability, compliance, or manufacturing companies
    • ISO, ESG, sustainability, supply chain, or regulatory documentation
  • Familiarity with AI tools or AI-assisted workflows
  • Experience working with Excel, Google Drive, SharePoint, or document management systems
  • Understanding of data privacy and confidentiality handling

This role is ideal for someone who:
  • Has worked in QA/QM or operations teams answering customer or certification-related questions
  • Knows how to navigate complex document structures
  • Enjoys reviewing, validating, and improving content quality
  • Wants to work closely with AI-driven products and shape how automation is built
What We Offer
  • Fully remote role
  • Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge AI product
  • High ownership and direct impact on product quality
  • Flexible work culture
  • Exposure to AI, RAG systems, and automation platforms

Required Skills

  • Job knowledge
  • Debugging and Solution suggestion
  • Decisiveness
  • Planning and Problem-Solving
  • Communication skills
  • Commitment/Accountability
  • Quality product delivery

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer who builds things that matter. You will design and ship end-to-end AI solutions for some of APACs most complex enterprise problems - spanning agentic AI systems, LLM applications, and production ML pipelines. This is a hands-on engineering role embedded within a customer-facing field team, meaning your work will be seen, used, and evaluated by real enterprises from day one.

You will work alongside Kaggle Grandmasters, ML engineers, and domain experts to deliver AI that goes beyond demos - into production, into workflows, and into measurable business outcomes.

This position is based in India.

Responsibilities

Agentic AI LLM Engineering

  • Design and build agentic AI systems and multi-agent frameworks that automate complex, multi-step workflows for enterprise customers.
  • Develop and deploy LLM-powered applications using techniques including RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, function calling, and tool use.
  • Build production-ready applications independently: backend services, frontend interfaces, and the AI/ML layer connecting them
  • Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI controls to ensure production-grade reliability and safety.
  • Stay current with the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape - MCP, LLM orchestration frameworks, reasoning models - and bring the best of it into customer engagements.

Predictive AI Machine Learning

  • Rapidly build, iterate, and deploy multiple predictive ML models (classification, regression, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection) for enterprise customers
  • Architect hybrid AI solutions that combine predictive ML (scoring, forecasting, classification) with Generative AI (natural language interfaces, RAG-based explanations, agentic orchestration)

End-to-End AI Application Development

  • Own the full development lifecycle: from problem framing and data exploration through model development, API integration, and production deployment.
  • Build scalable backend services and APIs that expose AI capabilities to enterprise applications and workflows.
  • Integrate AI models into customer environments - cloud, on-prem, and hybrid - ensuring performance, stability, and maintainability at scale.
  • Develop ML pipelines (for both predictive models and LLM applications) and MLOps/LLMOps infrastructure that support continuous model improvement, automated retraining, drift detection, and monitoring in production.

jobDescription:
Full-Stack Developer (AI-Native)


We are hiring a full-stack developer with strong AI engineering skills to own the applications, tools, and digital products we build in-house, end to end.


This is a hands-on ownership role. You will design and build our own web applications, internal tools and AI features, take them from prototype to production, keep them reliable and secure once live, and turn ideas into working products. You will also work alongside our existing engineers on the larger products we are building.


This is a role for someone who works fluently with AI development tools as a core part of how they operate. We expect you to use AI not just to write code faster, but to read and understand systems quickly, reason about technical decisions, and ship AI features with confidence. You also verify what the tools produce: you test it, probe it, and can explain what they got wrong and how you caught it. That fluency is central to the role.


This is a fully remote opportunity, operating in UK timezone.


Working: 5.5 days per week. Monday - Friday: 9am - 6pm UK time. Saturday: 9am - 1:30pm UK time.


The Role


You will:


* Design, build, and ship our own web applications, tools, and digital products end to end, across the full stack (React / Next.js front end, plus Node / TypeScript APIs, PostgreSQL, integrations, and auth).

* Build AI features into real products: LLM integrations, RAG, agents and structured outputs, with validation, fallbacks and evaluation so they hold up in production, not just in a demo.

* Own the back end and data layer of what you build: schema design, migrations, transactions, background jobs, webhooks, and third-party integrations (payments, messaging, email).

* Keep what we ship healthy once it is live: performance, reliability, security, uptime, monitoring, and fixes.

* Read, review and harden code you did not write, including code produced with AI tools, before it reaches production.

* Build high-quality, responsive front ends when the feature needs it, to a solid standard of polish, performance, and accessibility.

* Deploy and run what you build (Vercel, Google Cloud Run, Docker, CI/CD) and keep environments, secrets and pipelines tidy.

* Use AI development tools fluently throughout your work, to build, to understand unfamiliar code quickly, and to move fast without losing rigour.

* Turn early ideas into working prototypes fast, and take the ones that work through to production.


What we're looking for


* 3+ years building full-stack web applications, with a portfolio of live work you can speak to in depth.

* Strong, current full-stack skills: TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, APIs, auth, and integrations, with real back-end and data depth.

* Hands-on experience building and running AI features in production: LLM APIs, RAG, agents, prompt and output validation, evaluation, and the failure modes that come with them.

* A solid grasp of what goes wrong in real systems: authorisation on every data path, input validation, idempotency, concurrency, secrets, and logging.

* Demonstrable, fluent use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow, including using them to read and understand unfamiliar codebases quickly, and to check their own output.

* Clear communication and the confidence to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, in writing and in conversation, to technical and non-technical people.

* Comfort working independently in a remote, UK-timezone team and owning delivery end to end.


Nice to have: payments and webhooks in production (Razorpay, Stripe); background jobs and queues (Inngest, BullMQ); vector search and evaluation tooling; Postgres at depth (Prisma, Drizzle); Docker, Cloud Run, Vercel; design-tool familiarity (Figma); analytics tooling (GA4, GTM)

  • XAUUSD contract specifications
  • Margin and leverage
  • Hedging
  • Position sizing
  • Drawdown management

  • Trading sessions
  • High-impact economic news
  • Scalping strategy behaviour

  • Strong debugging and analytical ability.

Summary
Build AI native, enterprise-grade user experiences using SAPUI5 (and the broader SAP Fiori paradigm), combining deep front end engineering skills with agentic AI patterns (LLM-integrated UX, tool-augmented interactions, and evaluation loops). The focus is to move beyond forms and screens into intelligent, guided, and adaptive SAP experiences that help users complete business tasks fasterwhile maintaining performance, accessibility, security, and reliability at enterprise scale.

Core Responsibilities
1) Enterprise UI Engineering with SAPUI5
Build responsive, user-friendly SAPUI5 interfaces using MVC architecture, component-based patterns, and standard UI5 application structure.
Develop and customize UI5 applications using JavaScript and modern front-end foundations (JSON, CSS), following disciplined source control practices (Git).
2) Data Interaction Service Consumption (OData-first mindset)
Implement robust data flows using OData and service mocking practices for development and testing scenarios (e.g. mock services).
Design client-side models, bindings, and interaction patterns that scale across complex enterprise datasets.
3) AI Native UX:LLM-Integrated and Agentic Interfaces (AI native build expectation)
Embed AI-driven experiences directly into UI flows (e.g., assist in the moment interactions) where the UI can interpret intent, propose next steps, and generate contextual guidance.
Implement tool-augmented UI patterns (front-end orchestration that can call approved tools/services), with clear user confirmation steps and safe action boundaries.
Build retrieval-grounded UI interactions (RAG-style grounding) where AI outputs must stay tied to enterprise knowledge and business context, with deterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak.
4) Testing, Quality UX Reliability
Build automated test coverage with a strong testing approach for UI components using unit and acceptance testing patterns (e.g., QUnit and one page acceptance tests/OPA style approaches).
Optimize performance and maintainability:reduce UI bloat, apply reusable components, and enforce consistent coding standards for long-term supportability. 5) SAP Fiori-aligned Experience Design
Apply SAP Fiori s design principles and UX paradigm to deliver role-based, consistent experiences across devices, aligned to modern SAP UX expectations.
Understand the ecosystem positioning of SAPUI5 and OpenUI5 and make informed choices based on enterprise constraints and licensing contexts.
6) Iteration, Delivery Collaboration
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate with business stakeholdersthen harden into production-ready UI solutions with observability and regression testing for both UI and AI behaviors.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
Strong hands-on expertise in SAP UI5 / SAPUI5 development and enterprise UI engineering fundamentals.
Mastery of MVC architecture, responsive UI construction, and component-driven development in SAP UI5 contexts.
Solid implementation experience with OData and service mocking approaches for development/test workflows.
Strong front-end foundations:JavaScript + JSON + CSS, with Git-based collaboration.
AI-native build capability:designing UX that integrates LLM behaviors with grounding, tool use, and evaluation loops (owned by the role). (AI native expectation not a claim about a specific SAP feature.)

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
SAP Fiori design paradigm familiarity and ability to translate UX principles into scalable UI solutions.
Testing depth for SAPUI5 applications using the testing approaches referenced in learning assets.
Understanding of SAPUI5 vs OpenUI5 positioning and implications for enterprise delivery.

What This Role Does Not Center On
Not limited to AI-assisted coding or only using copilots this role builds AI-native UI behaviors and owns their quality (grounding, safety boundaries, evaluation).
Not focused on model training emphasis is on productizing intelligent experiences in the UI layer with reliable integration patterns.

Value Delivered
Enterprise SAP applications with modern, responsive SAPUI5 interfaces aligned to SAP Fiori UX expectations.
Faster user outcomes through AI-native in-flow guidance and agentic task completion patterns (grounded, safe, and measurable).
Higher reliability via disciplined testing practices for UI components and acceptance flows.

A 15 years full time education is required

About The Role

Project Role :Business Process Architect

Assist in quality management reviews, ensure all business and design requirements are met. Educate stakeholders to ensure a complete understanding of the designs.
Must have skills :SAP Quality Management (QM)

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum

5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Quality Management (QM) processes while leveraging AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate configuration, documentation, process analysis, testing, and problem resolution. The role focuses on delivering robust quality processes across the supply chain, integrating pre built AI services when beneficial, and improving productivity through AI enabled assistancewithout requiring deep AI model engineering or RAG/agentic development.


Key Responsibilities
QM Functional Technical Delivery
Configure and enhance SAP QM processes across:
oInspection Planning Results Recording
oQuality Notifications Corrective Actions
oIncoming, In Process, and Final Inspections
oQuality Certificates, Sampling Procedures, and Catalogs
oIntegration with Procurement, Production, and Warehouse
Use AI copilots to accelerate creation of functional specifications, streamline configuration validation, and generate comprehensive test cases.
Support end to end delivery across requirements, solution design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, and hypercare.
Integrate QM processes with MM, PP, WM/EWM, PM, SD, and vendor/customer facing systems.
AI Assisted Productivity
Use AI copilots for:
oRapid requirement summarization
oImpact analysis on inspection types and quality workflows
oAuto generation of documentation (FS/TS/SOPs)
oFaster test case creation for various inspection scenarios
oPattern detection in quality issues, defects, and notifications
Leverage pre built AI services for:
oIntelligent classification of defects and notifications
oPredictive quality signals (e.g., expected defect rates)
oAutomated summarization of quality issues across plants/batches
Apply LLM assisted troubleshooting for quicker resolution of QM configuration or process issues.
Governance, Quality Collaboration
Ensure all QM processes adhere to organizational quality standards, regulatory requirements, audit controls, and compliance frameworks.
Conduct workshops, solution walkthroughs, and root cause analysis using AI generated insights.
Collaborate with procurement, production, warehouse, engineering, quality labs, and technical integration teams.
Contribute to reusable templates, configuration accelerators, inspection plans, and AI enabled best practices.

Required Skills Experience
SAP QM Expertise
Hands on experience with SAP QM including inspection types, quality notifications, inspection lots, usage decisions, catalogs, MICs, sample procedures, and control indicators.
Understanding of integration dependencies with MM (incoming inspection), PP (in process/production inspections), WM/EWM, SD, and vendor quality.
Experience with quality reports, certificates, and data analysis of inspection results.
AI Ready Skills
Experience using AI copilots, LLM driven documentation tools, and AI assisted testing/troubleshooting accelerators.
Ability to integrate pre built AI capabilities (not custom model/RAG development) into QM operations where appropriate.
Understanding of responsible AI usage, especially in regulated quality and manufacturing environments.
General Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to quality processes and defect patterns.
Ability to translate quality and manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP QM configurations.
Clear communication and collaboration skills across business and IT teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI augmented productivity workflows.

Good to Have
SAP QM Certification.
Exposure to LIMS systems, quality labs, or HACCP/GxP environments.
Knowledge of statistical quality control or manufacturing analytics.
Experience with automated testing tools or workflow automation platforms.

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more accurate SAP QM solutions using AI assisted productivity enhancements.
Improve product quality, defect traceability, and compliance using quality data insights.
Act as a bridge between quality teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native teams when deeper AI involvement is required.

Additional information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

Project Role :Custom Software Engineer




Project Role Description :Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.


Must have skills :SAP MM Materials Management



Good to have skills :NA
Minimum

3 year(s) of experience is required



Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

"""

Summary:We are seeking a forward-thinking professional with AI-first mindset to design, develop, and deploy intelligent frameworks leveraging Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI frameworks within SAP platforms. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of various Business Functions, a passion for innovation in AI, and rich experience with delivering enterprise grade technology solutions using Gen AI / Agentic AI Frameworks. This role requires the ability to conceptualize and implement AI-driven enhancements to traditional SAP processes, driving the next generation of enterprise automation and intelligence.As an Application Developer, you will design, build, and configure applications to meet business process and application requirements. A typical day involves collaborating with various teams to understand their needs, developing innovative solutions, and ensuring that applications are aligned with business objectives. You will engage in problem-solving activities, participate in meetings to discuss project progress, and contribute to the overall success of the application development process. Your role will also include testing and refining applications to enhance functionality and user experience, ensuring that the final product meets the highest standards of quality and performance.Roles & Responsibilities:Expected to be a Subject Matter Expert with deep knowledge and experience.While the business situation / problem is given – you will have responsibility to visualize innovative solutions leveraging’s GenAI & Agentic architecture and the best of available technologies from SAP, and other providers.
  • Engage in end-to-end AI-enabled project delivery:requirement gathering, solution design, implementation, testing, and business adoption.
  • Work with real-time AI platforms, integrating AI insights into enterprise decision-making workflows
  • Should have influencing and advisory skills.
  • Responsible for team decisions.
  • Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
  • Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
  • Facilitate workshops and discussions to gather requirements and feedback from stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior professionals in best practices and application development methodologies.
  • Professional & Technical Skills:
  • Ability to bridge technical AI concepts with business goals, ensuring timely delivery and stakeholder alignment.
  • Hands-on experience in GenAI (LLMs, embeddings, vector databases) and Agentic AI applications (multi-agent systems, planning, reasoning) – demonstrated through project implementations
  • Strong fundamental knowledge of AI lifecycle, data analysis, statistical concepts of ML algorithms (supervised and unsupervised learning) and AI concepts of NN (Neural Networks) and NLP (Natural Language Processing)
  • Solid grasp of prompt engineering, AI evaluation frameworks, value realization in AI projects
    Must To Have Skills:
  • Proficiency in SAP MM Materials Management.
  • Strong understanding of application development frameworks and methodologies.
  • Experience with integration of SAP MM with other SAP modules.
  • Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Familiarity with database management and data modeling techniques.

  • Additional Information:- The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in SAP MM Materials Management."""

     Qualification 15 years full time education

Summary
Build AI native enterprise applications on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) by combining strong platform engineering (admin + solution design + full stack build) with agentic AI application patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). This role is about building, deploying, and operating cloud applications on SAP BTP, and evolving them into intelligent systems through rapid prototyping and production hardening.

Core Responsibilities
1) Cloud Application Engineering on SAP BTP
Build, deploy, and manage applications in a cloud-based environment on SAP BTP, covering platform fundamentals, administration touchpoints, solution design, and both frontend and backend development.
2) Full Stack Delivery (Frontend + Backend) with SAP BTP Patterns
Develop backend services and APIs (including CRUD + business logic + validations) using Node.js-based service patterns, and expose services for frontend consumption.
Build responsive UI components using SAPUI5 (XML views, controllers, MVC approach) and integrate with backend APIs for data display and write-back flows.
3) Data Modeling Persistence Foundations
Design database artifacts and data models (tables/views/entities/relationships) and connect applications to SAP HANA-based persistence patterns used in BTP app development scenarios.
4) Platform Setup Deployment Engineering
Configure subaccounts/service instances/roles and set up development spaces configure connectivity artifacts (e.g., destinations) for integrating external APIs and databases as part of application delivery.
Package and deploy applications using multi-target application (MTA) style deployment artifacts where applicable.
5) AI Native Application Patterns (Agentic + LLM Integrated) (Build expectation)
Implement LLM-integrated features as part of BTP applications (e.g., assistant in the workflow ), including:tool calling, orchestration, memory/state handling, and safe action boundaries.
Build retrieval-grounded experiences (RAG-style) over enterprise content and APIs where the solution requires grounded responses, with clear fallback behaviors.
Create evaluation loops (offline test sets + online monitoring) so AI behavior changes are measurable and regressions are caught early.
6) Engineering Excellence (Quality, DevOps, Collaboration)
Use Git-based workflows for source control and collaboration, and operate in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
Debug and resolve backend/database/service exposure issues encountered during full-stack delivery.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP BTP application development fundamentals spanning platform architecture, administration basics, solution design, and frontend/backend build.
Hands-on full-stack implementation patterns evidenced by:backend services + APIs + data models + UI integration.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (clean code, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation) and ability to move from prototype to production (AI native expectation).

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Practical exposure to common BTP app-dev tooling and patterns used in delivery environments (e.g., SAP Business Application Studio usage in full-stack build contexts).
Familiarity with structured learning paths such as BTP Application Development (training listing) and bootcamp-style enablement.
Awareness of platform building blocks and guidelines referenced in community materials like SAP BTP Developer s Guide .

What This Role Does Not Center On
Not limited to AI-assisted development only this role owns AI behavior in the product (orchestration, grounding, evaluation, safety boundaries) as part of delivery (AI native expectation).
Not focused on training foundation models from scratch emphasis is on building agentic applications integrated with enterprise services.

Value Delivered
Rapid delivery of cloud applications on SAP BTP with full-stack rigor (platform + backend + UI + deployment).
Higher-impact solutions by embedding agentic AI capabilities into business workflows while maintaining engineering discipline and operational reliability (AI native expectation).


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required
Qualification15 years full time education

Must have skills :SAP PP Production Planning Control Discrete Industries

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Production Planning (PP) processes for discrete manufacturing environments while using AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. The role focuses on delivering efficient production planning, shop floor execution, and material staging processes while integrating pre built AI services where beneficial. No deep AI model engineering, vector DB work, RAG, or agentic system development is required.


Key Responsibilities
Functional Technical Delivery
Configure and support SAP PP processes including:
oMaterial Requirement Planning (MRP)
oProduction Orders Execution
oRoutings, Work Centers BOM Management
oCapacity Planning Scheduling
oBackflushing Costing Integration
oGoods Movements Shop floor Reporting
Use AI copilots to accelerate:
oFunctional specification creation
oRouting/BOM validation
oTest case generation for MRP, order creation, confirmations
oDocumentation automation (FS/TS/SOPs)
Support full lifecycle delivery:requirements, design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, hypercare support.
Integrate PP with MM, QM, SD, FI/CO, and shop floor systems (MES), leveraging standard APIs and middleware.
AI Assisted Productivity
Use AI copilots for:
oAutomated summarization of requirements and change impacts
oAnalysis of MRP exceptions and planning alerts
oValidation of order execution and production variances
oFaster defect isolation in BOM/routing/work center configurations
Integrate pre built AI services into production workflows, such as:
oPredictive insights (e.g., potential material shortages or order delays)
oIntelligent classification of production issues
oAutomated summarization of production batch deviations
oSmart suggestions based on historical production performance
Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce time spent analyzing MRP exception messages, order failures, and material shortages.
Governance, Quality Collaboration
Ensure compliance with production governance, change controls, data accuracy standards, and audit policies.
Participate in workshops, solution reviews, and process optimization discussions enhanced by AI generated insights.
Collaborate with production, quality, warehouse, procurement, cost controlling, and integration teams to deliver end to end planning excellence.
Create reusable templates, checklists, test packs, and AI enabled best practices for SAP PP delivery.

Required Skills Experience
SAP PP Expertise
Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes including BOM/routing management, production order cycles, capacity planning, scheduling, and MRP.
Experience with integration across MM (material availability), QM (inspection lots), SD (demand), and FI/CO (costing).
Familiarity with order confirmations, settlements, and shop floor data capture processes.
AI Ready Skills
Ability to use AI copilots, automated documentation tools, and AI assisted test accelerators.
Comfortable embedding pre built AI capabilities into production planning or execution (not custom model building).
Awareness of responsible AI usage and limitations in manufacturing and planning environments.
General Professional Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to production variability, MRP outcomes, and resource planning.
Ability to translate manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP PP configurations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and operational teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

Good to Have
SAP PP Certification (S/4HANA Manufacturing).
Experience with MES systems, shop floor integrations, or IoT enabled production data.
Exposure to EWM/WM, PM, or APO/IBP environments.
Familiarity with automated testing tools (Tricentis, CBTA).

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more reliable SAP PP solutions using AI enabled productivity tools.
Improve planning accuracy, resource utilization, and production stability.
Act as a bridge between manufacturing teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native experts when deeper AI capabilities are required.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

CRM Functional Technical Delivery

oLead Management Territory Management
oActivities, Tasks Interactions

AI Assisted Productivity
Apply AI copilots for:
oRequirement summarization
oPipeline data interpretation
oImpact analysis
oAutomated documentation
oTest script generation
Utilize pre built AI capabilities to enrich CRM processesfor example:
oLead scoring using pre-trained AI services
oAutomated summarization of customer interactions
oClassification of sales tickets or cases
oDuplicate detection for contacts or opportunities
Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce time spent resolving defects and configuration inconsistencies.
Governance, Quality Collaboration
Ensure alignment with SDLC processes, sales governance rules, audit requirements, and customer data protection guidelines.
Participate in workshops, design reviews, and solution optimization sessions supported by AI driven analysis and insights.
Collaborate with sales teams, marketing, customer service, data teams, and integration teams to ensure smooth end to end processes.
Contribute to reusable CRM templates, configuration guidelines, and AI enhanced documentation best practices.

Required Skills Experience
SAP CRM Sales Expertise
Hands on experience across CRM Sales functionalities including opportunities, leads, quotations, pricing, partner processing, and actions.

Familiarity with customer master data, business partner roles, organizational model, and transaction processing.
AI Ready Skills
Experience using AI copilots, automated documentation accelerators, and AI-assisted test or configuration validation tools.

Strong problem solving and analytical skills in customer/sales processes.
Ability to translate business requirements into scalable CRM solutions.
Clear communication and stakeholder management skills across business and IT teams.
Continuous learning mindset and comfort working with AI supported tools.

Good to Have
Experience with SAP C4C / SAP Customer Experience (CX) suite.
SAP CRM Sales Certification.
Exposure to integrations with CPQ, e commerce platforms, or mobile sales applications.
Familiarity with workflow automation and CRM related analytics.

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more accurate SAP CRM Sales solutions using AI enabled productivity enhancements.
Improve sales process transparency, forecasting accuracy, and customer engagement.
Act as a bridge between sales, CRM engineering teams, and AI native teams when advanced AI inputs are needed.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

oAutomated summarization of requirements and change impacts

oValidation of order execution and production variances

oPredictive insights (e.g., potential material shortages or order delays)

Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

SAP PP Certification (S/4HANA Manufacturing).

Deliver faster, more reliable SAP PP solutions using AI enabled productivity tools.

A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification 15 years full time education

Implement message mappings and data transformations for common enterprise formats (e.g., JSON, XML, CSV), ensuring semantic correctness and downstream compatibility.
Apply canonical modeling and contract-first practices to reduce brittle point-to-point dependencies.

Use scripting (e.g., Groovy) to implement complex transformation logic, enrichment, validation, and conditional execution paths.
Implement message persistence patterns (e.g., data stores) to support idempotency, retries, correlation, and resilience.

Integrate with third party applications using connector-based approaches and standardized integration patterns.
Enable event-driven integration approaches using messaging/event capabilities for near real-time propagation and decoupled architectures.

Build integration agents that can generate initial iFlows from system/endpoint selections and naming conventions, then validate them against enterprise standards.
Implement retrieval-grounded assistance that pulls from interface catalogs, mapping specs, standards, runbooks, and known incident patterns to produce verifiable recommendations (no free-form guessing).
Apply intelligent recommendations for mapping and configuration, accelerating build and reducing rework.
Develop AI-driven anomaly detection and prediction for integration/API behavior (error spikes, latency patterns), with human-in-the-loop controls for remediation actions.
Optimize and analyze scripts used in integration flows for performance and maintainability through AI-assisted code analysis techniques.
6) Testing, Quality Engineering Evaluation Loops
Build automated testing strategies for integrations:schema/contract validation, payload regression suites, replay testing, and API testing tool-driven verification.
Implement AI evaluation harnesses (offline golden test sets + online monitoring) for generated mappings, generated flows, and operational recommendations.
Establish release gates for both integration changes and AI prompt/tool updates to prevent silent degradation.
7) Monitoring, Troubleshooting Observability
Set up monitoring dashboards and alerts for flows, APIs, and event-driven pipelines establish traceability with correlation IDs and end-to-end tracking.
Diagnose and resolve integration issues using structured logs, message traces, and failure-mode analysis.
Create AI-native operational experiences such as conversational root-cause analysis, runbook-guided remediation, and impact analysisbounded by role-based access and approval workflows.
8) Integration Strategy Maturity Enablement
Apply integration advisory practices to design hybrid integration platforms and define integration best practices across teams.
Use integration assessment approaches to improve integration maturity, standardize patterns, and automate repeatable architectural governance where feasible.
